title: Made trace stages expand inline
points: Failure case: stage details still appeared as a separate area below the trace chain, so the opened content felt disconnected from the block the user clicked.
Display logic changed: each trace stage is now an inline drill-down block that opens its detail directly underneath and collapses when clicked again.
Shipped result: users can scan Plan, Retrieve, Compute, Write, and Verify as blocks, then drill into one step without losing position in the chain.
